test_title: PYST 10: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: What sum (in ₹) will earn a simple interest of ₹240 in 3 years at 16% per year rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹240

Time (T) = 3 years

Rate of Interest (R) = 16% per year

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

Let the principal amount be P.

SI = (P × 16 × 3) / 100

240 = (48P) / 100

⇒ 240 = 0.48P

⇒ P = 240 / 0.48

⇒ P = 500

**The sum that will earn a simple interest of ₹240 in 3 years at 16% per year rate of interest is ₹500.**
